settings.title: Everything you need to send,
settings.intro: From a drag-and-drop builder to deliverability tools that protect your sender reputation, Postmark covers the whole journey — without the bloat.

features.title: Drag-and-drop builder
features.text: Compose responsive campaigns on a live canvas. Blocks for every need — buttons, products, countdowns — that look right on any phone.

features.title: Deliverability that's earned
features.text: Warm-up tools, spam-score checks, and a dedicated IP option keep your sender reputation high so your mail reaches the inbox.

features.title: Segmentation that's simple
features.text: Build audiences from your own data with point-and-click rules. Send the right message to the right people, automatically.

features.title: Automation without code
features.text: Welcome series, win-backs, and lifecycle flows that trigger on real behavior — set once, run forever.

features.title: Reports that tell the truth
features.text: Open, click, and conversion data in real time, with honest attribution. Know what worked and what to change next.

features.title: A/B test everything
features.text: Test subject lines, send times, and content against real audiences. Postmark picks the winner and applies it for you.

settings.title: From draft to delivered,

steps.title: Import your audience
steps.text: Bring in your contacts from a CSV, your CRM, or an API. Postmark cleans and dedupes as it loads, so you start with a healthy list.

steps.title: Design your campaign
steps.text: Pick a template or start from a blank canvas. Drag in your content, add your brand colors, and preview it on every device.

steps.title: Send to the inbox
steps.text: Hit send. Postmark routes your mail through warm, trusted infrastructure and watches your deliverability in real time.

steps.title: Read the real results
steps.text: Watch opens, clicks, and conversions roll in. Use the honest numbers to refine your next send — and repeat.

settings.note: Most teams send their first campaign the same day they sign up. No IT ticket, no deliverability degree, no guesswork.

settings.title: Flat, honest pricing
settings.intro: Every plan includes unlimited contacts, a drag-and-drop builder, and real-time analytics. Upgrade when you want more sends, not sooner than you need them.

settings.title: Questions, answered
settings.intro: The honest answers teams ask before moving their email to Postmark.

items.question: Will my emails actually reach the inbox?
items.answer: That's the whole point. Postmark combines warm-up tools, spam-score checks, and trusted sending infrastructure to protect your sender reputation. Our average inbox placement is 98%.

items.question: Can I import my existing list and templates?
items.answer: Yes. Bring contacts from a CSV, CRM, or API, and import your existing HTML templates or start fresh with our builder. Nothing is locked in.

items.question: Is it really no-code?
items.answer: Yes. If you can lay out a slide, you can build a Postmark campaign. Engineers can go deeper with our API, but no one has to.

items.question: What happens if I want to leave?
items.answer: Your contacts, templates, and data are yours. Export everything anytime — Postmark never holds your audience hostage.
